title: Pc hub
features: Um script que te faz um pc em celular
script:
-- Serviços
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Criando ScreenGui para o Cursor
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "VirtualMouseGui"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

if gethui then
    ScreenGui.Parent = gethui()
elseif syn and syn.protect_gui then
    syn.protect_gui(ScreenGui)
    ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
else
    ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-- Ícone do Cursor de PC
local Cursor = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
Cursor.Name = "VirtualCursor"
Cursor.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)
Cursor.Image = "rbxassetid://6031097225" -- ID da imagem de seta do mouse
Cursor.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Cursor.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Cursor.ZIndex = 1000
Cursor.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
Cursor.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
Cursor.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Posição do Mouse Virtual
local virtualMousePos = Vector2.new(
    workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
    workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y / 2
)

-- Atualização da Posição do Cursor Visual
local function updateCursorPosition()
    Cursor.Position = UDim2.new(0, virtualMousePos.X, 0, virtualMousePos.Y)
end
updateCursorPosition()

-- Lógica do Trackpad (Arrastar na tela move a seta)
local lastTouchPos = nil

UserInputService.TouchStarted:Connect(function(touch, gameProcessed)
    lastTouchPos = Vector2.new(touch.Position.X, touch.Position.Y)
end)

UserInputService.TouchMoved:Connect(function(touch, gameProcessed)
    if lastTouchPos then
        local currentTouchPos = Vector2.new(touch.Position.X, touch.Position.Y)
        local delta = currentTouchPos - lastTouchPos
        
        -- Sensibilidade do Trackpad
        local sensitivity = 1.2
        
        -- Atualizar coordenadas virtuais mantendo dentro da tela
        local viewportSize = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
        virtualMousePos = Vector2.new(
            math.clamp(virtualMousePos.X + (delta.X * sensitivity), 0, viewportSize.X),
            math.clamp(virtualMousePos.Y + (delta.Y * sensitivity), 0, viewportSize.Y)
        )
        
        updateCursorPosition()
